Optibus’ global week took 450 guests to the Athens Riviera in September 2022 — conference days, a bespoke build created for the client, and leisure along the coast.

The coverage mixes ground photography on a Sony full-frame body with aerial drone frames logged over the Riviera on 4 and 6 September.
